_comment: Per-nation ramp rosters — Theater Identity P1, second slice. When a base is aligned to a nation (theater_identity.json), the fast-jet TYPES parked there come from that nation's roster instead of the generic side theme, so an Israeli base flies F-15/F-16 (IDF skins), Iran flies the F-14A, GDR flies MiGs, RAF/Luftwaffe fly the Tornado. Only the 'planes' list is nation-specific; transports/tankers ('large') and helos fall back to the side theme (a C-130 is a C-130). Refs are pydcs module paths, era-gated by the block they sit in — every ref verified to exist and fit its era window. A nation with no roster for an era falls back to the side theme (livery is still nation-correct via the aligned country).
